args.reason: The old decision forbids writing secrets to `.faff/` at all; it does not depend on whether the path is gitignored. The new decision writes literal provider API keys to `.faff/cache/credentials.json`, which directly breaks that rule. Gitignore only stops a commit; it does not stop the keys being read by other local processes, copied into backups or archived run directories, or swept into logs and evidence bundles that faff already writes under `.faff/`. The stated benefit is unmeasured: reading `process.env` is an in-memory lookup and is negligible next to an LLM network call, and an in-process memo would get any real gain without a file on disk. The argument does not show that the old decision's reasons have stopped holding, so the supersession is unsound.
